title: Wolf's Den Family Campground

services.name: Property Damage to Campground
services.desc: Thank you for choosing to stay at Wolf’s Den Family Campground. We are happy to have you as our guests. The following rules are intended to provide an enjoyable family camping experience for you and your neighbors. Parents are advised to inform their children of these rules and are responsible for their supervision. Violation of these rules could mean early departure without a refund. Regulations can be modified at any time. Camping rates are per family (two adults and up to four children). Camping sites include cable and wifi. No sewer on sites. Free dump station on-premises. No tents allowed. All refunds which were originally paid by credit card, must be processed to the original credit

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Kick back and escape for a while at Wolf’s Den Campground, located in the beautiful Connecticut River Valley. Whether for the day, week, month or season, experience all we have to offer from comfy on-site conveniences to exciting themed weekend events!
